rating.label: Team strength
rating.test: the whole engine replayed cold on 2022-2025, seasons no layer was tuned on
rating.result: spread MAE 12.769 on 3127 games against the closing line’s 12.015; rating and home field alone: 12.989
rating.status_text: The model’s base, tested as a whole

home_field.label: Home field
home_field.points_text: 2.8 pts for every home team, the same at every stadium (0 at a neutral site)
home_field.test: walk-forward 2014-2025, 8724 games, against the previous 4.082-pt constant
home_field.result: spread MAE −0.052 (95% CI −0.08 to −0.02), better in 11/12 seasons; a per-stadium table was tested and rejected: it tracked the home team’s own rating (corr 0.77), not the stadium

matchup.label: Stylistic matchup
matchup.points_text: 8 offence-vs-defence pairings on both sides of the ball (run, pass, trenches, explosives, early downs, red zone, field position), netted into one term
matchup.test: weights fitted on 2014-2019 residuals (4331 games, in-sample r² 0.023)
matchup.result: no held-out test of its own: the historical replay carries no play-level efficiency, so the term is absent from every out-of-sample record
matchup.status_text: In the number, not yet tested on unseen games by itself

altitude.label: Altitude

travel.label: Travel

rivalry.label: Rivalry

rivalry.status_text: Tested on unseen games and rejected: adds 0

regime.status_text: In the number, held-out gain not significant
